# ui::TextLayoutOptions

Header: `winui/render/TextLayout.hpp`.

How [TextLayout::layout()](text-layout.md#layout) breaks and aligns lines: the paragraph-level settings a [TextControl](../controls/text.md#uitextcontrol) or [RichText](../controls/rich-text.md#uirichtext) passes down.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_width` | `float` | `0.0f` | The width lines break at, and the width alignment works in. 0 or less, or infinity, is unbounded: no line breaks but the hard ones, and lines aligned within the widest. |
| `wrapping` | `TextWrapping` | `TextWrapping::NoWrap` | Whether and how lines break at `max_width`; NoWrap keeps only the hard breaks. |
| `alignment` | `TextAlignment` | `TextAlignment::Left` | Where each line sits across the width. |
| `base_style` | `TextStyle` |  | The style an empty paragraph (or one with no runs) takes its line height from. |
